spans.claim: Sir Harris Greaves was stabbed in his bed
spans.anchor: stabbed in his bed
spans.span: According to the published accounts, Sir Harris was stabbed in his bed, presumably during the early morning hours, though no sound was heard, and the crime wasn't discovered until his man went to take Sir Harris his tea at the usual hour this morning.

spans.claim: Captain Francis Newcombe was last to speak with Sir Harris
spans.anchor: last one as had any conversation with Sir Harris
spans.span: You are the last one as had any conversation with Sir Harris before he was murdered.

spans.claim: Paul Cremarre was found dead under the boathouse
spans.anchor: Paul Cremarre found here on the island, whether dead or alive
spans.span: Paul Cremarre found here on the island, whether dead or alive, was what mattered--it meant that the menace, that hellish nightmare of the "unknown," that had been hanging over him, Shadow Varne, was gone now--that the way was clear ahead--a fortune here--America once more an "open sesame"--riches, luxury, all he had builded for, his again to take at his leisure without fear now of any interference from any source.

spans.claim: Paul Cremarre's body had marks consistent with octopus attack
spans.anchor: His face and throat were covered with round, purplish blotches
spans.span: His face and throat were covered with round, purplish blotches, and the man was absolutely mangled.

spans.claim: Captain Francis Newcombe is Shadow Varne, the criminal mastermind
spans.anchor: Shadow Varne!  Shadow Varne!  Ha, ha!
spans.span: Shadow Varne! Shadow Varne! Ha, ha! Ha, ha!

spans.claim: The money is hidden in a tide-locked vault under the boathouse

spans.claim: The vault door is a concrete block swinging open at low tide
spans.anchor: The movable block swung back and inward from its upper edge

spans.claim: Captain Francis Newcombe kills Runnells by locking him in the vault
spans.anchor: The minutes passed.  The candle flickered and went out.

spans.claim: Captain Francis Newcombe escapes with the money by swimming ashore
spans.anchor: They stepped out on the shore.
spans.span: Presently they stepped out on the shore. Captain Francis Newcombe stared up and down the beach, as he seated himself on the sand and began to pull on his boots.

spans.claim: Polly Wickes' true parentage is concealed by Newcombe
spans.anchor: Polly's papers which is God's truth

spans.claim: Runnells made a threatening telephone call to Polly
spans.anchor: Some one is playing a cruel hoax; or it is the work of an unhinged mind
spans.span: Either some one is playing a cruel hoax; or it is the work of an unhinged mind, an irrational act, a phase of insanity that--" "Guardy!

spans.claim: The masked man on the island was not Newcombe but another criminal
spans.anchor: The man who had worn the mask was gone now
spans.span: The man who had worn the mask was gone now--naturally.

spans.claim: Old Mr. Marlin was mentally ill and obsessed with his money
spans.anchor: Mr. Marlin is dead.  Locke's eyes half closed

spans.claim: Paul Cremarre attempted to steal the money but was killed by an octopus
spans.anchor: The reason I know this is because I saw the creature
spans.span: The reason I know this is because I saw the creature--the tide was higher, of course, when I found the body--come back and carry off its prey.

spans.claim: Captain Francis Newcombe was seen near the old man's hut at 3 AM
spans.anchor: I saw you coming from that direction at three o'clock this morning
spans.span: I saw you coming from that direction at three o'clock this morning.

spans.claim: Captain Francis Newcombe's attempt to find the money was unsuccessful
spans.anchor: Newcombe was the one who had been on the wrong scent
spans.span: It meant that Newcombe was the one who had been tricked by the old madman's cunning, which could never have happened if Newcombe had not been stealthily trying to find the hidden money; it simply meant that Newcombe was the one who had been on the wrong scent--and that some one else had been on the right one!

spans.claim: Captain Francis Newcombe's identity as Shadow Varne was known to Locke
spans.anchor: I am the fourth straggler

spans.claim: Captain Francis Newcombe arranged to leave the island with Runnells and luggage
spans.anchor: Your baggage has been searched--so has Runnells'
spans.span: Your baggage has been searched--so has Runnells'.

spans.claim: Captain Francis Newcombe is forced to leave to avoid exposure
spans.anchor: You are going out of her life never to contaminate it again
spans.span: But you are going out of her life never to contaminate it again.

spans.claim: Captain Francis Newcombe's plan is foiled by Locke's intervention
spans.anchor: You are clever--but your cleverness will do you no good here
